I've replied in the thread in #central-random. The ticket is #8841.

Where it comes from: yesterday (Oct 13, 09:27) Tobias said in #central-random that West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he flagged it on ticket #8841 for support. Pree is in that channel, so she can see that message herself.

He was talking about "Tobias's dealer account" and never named Marrow Fieldworks. I treated it as Marrow Fieldworks because the Central handoff digest says the dealer account changed hands on Jan 5. In my reply I stated that link as fact, though it's my inference.

I also warned her not to confuse it with #88412, which is the Tansleigh Packaging Door 6 scanner ticket.

The knowledge brain refused the search because its access isn't set up for a specific person. So I checked only the channels and public files Pree can see. There's no ticket file I can see for this, so I couldn't confirm the ticket's current status; I told her to check with Tobias or support before her call.
